aboutText: Dynamic Heating & Cooling was established in 1998, born and bred in Essendon. As a family-operated business, we specialise in the repairs, service and maintenance of residential, commercial and industrial heating and cooling equipment across Melbourne's Inner, Western and Northern Metropolitan areas. We are committed to modern, efficient systems and responsible environmental practices.
servicesText: From domestic ducted heating to large commercial rooftop units and industrial water chillers, we provide comprehensive service, maintenance and repair solutions to keep your environment comfortable year-round.

services.title: Heating Systems
services.desc: Expert repair and service for ducted gas heaters and all types of heating equipment.

services.title: Air Conditioning
services.desc: Comprehensive service for split systems, central plants and all air conditioning units.

services.title: Ventilation
services.desc: Installation, maintenance and repair of ventilation systems for optimal air quality.

services.title: Maintenance & Service
services.desc: Regular preventative maintenance to keep your systems running efficiently and avoid breakdowns.

services.title: Process Cooling
services.desc: Specialised cooling solutions including water chillers for industrial and commercial processes.

services.title: Independent Reports
services.desc: Professional engineering reports for assessments, compliance and system specifications.

reviews.text: Had our ducted gas heater serviced before winter. The technician was punctual, knowledgeable and explained everything. Great to have a local Kensington company we can rely on for future maintenance.
reviews.name: Mark Thompson

reviews.text: Dynamic maintains the air conditioning for our entire office block. Their scheduled service keeps everything running perfectly and their response to any issues is always swift. Highly recommend for commercial HVAC.
reviews.name: Sarah Jenkins

reviews.text: Used them for an independent engineering report on an old system. The report was thorough and clear, helping us make an informed decision. Very professional service from the Kensington team.
reviews.name: David Chen
